tei:div.tei:p: (385)sgyu 'phrul dra ba las mkha' 'gro dkyil 'khor du bsnyen pa'i tshul gyis lhan thabs rig 'dzin dga' ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ chos nyid zhi las ma g.yos kyang*/ 'bar ba khrag 'thung khro bo'i tshogs/ dbyer med dpal ldan bla ma la/ rnam kun dang pas phyag byas te/ gang zhig lam 'dir 'jug pa la/ ma nor gnad kyi man ngag ni/ zhal nas snyan du brgyud pa yi/ shin tu gsang ba'i yi ge spel/ de la 'dir sgyu 'phrul zhi ba'i bsnyen pa sngon du song nas/ khro bo'i bsnyen pa la 'jug par 'dod pa dag gis shes par byed pa la gsum/ sgrub pa po'i gang zag sgrub pa'i lam rim/ grub pa'i 'bras bu'o/ dang po ni/ sgrub pa po dkyil 'khor chen po 'dir zhugs shing phyi nang gi dbang thob pa/ rtsa ba dang yan lag gi dam tshig la yang dag par gnas pa'o/ gnyis pa lam la sngon 'gro dang dngos gzhi rjes kyi rim pa gsum sgyu 'phrul zhi ba'i bsnyen yig tu ji skad bshad pa ltar las/ 'dir ni khro bo'i dgos chos nye bar mkho ba 'ga' zhig brjod par bya'o/ de yang gnas dur khrod dang ri bo dben pa gsung (386)kyang zhi khro gnyis sbrel te bsnyen pa btang na/ zhi ba'i bsnyen pa btang ba'i gnas las gzhan mi dgos la/ bla ma gong ma'i zhal rgyun la zhi ba gnas dag dang*/ khro bo gnas gyur du sgrub pa yin pas/ dong zhi ba'i bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i las rung tsam sngon du ma song na khro bo sgrub pa 'tshubs che zhing 'chun dka' bar gsungs pa bzhin/ 'dir yang zhi bsnyen sngon du song ba'i gang zag gis/ khro bor yang bsnyen pa btang na rgyud sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen po'i rgyud don gyi gnad ma tshang ba maid pa lags pas/ dus yun 'gor ba tsam gyi le lo dang snyoms las spangs te/ zhi khro gnyis ka la bsnyen pa zhig btang na dal 'byor gyi lus rten lan gcig rnyed pa la snying po legs par lon pa yin pas dga' spro dang bcas pas 'jug par rigs so/

de yang phying mchod gtor sogs mkho ba'i yo byad rnams tshogs par byas nas/ gza' skar legs par phyi dro dbang gi dus su mtshams kyi dbu 'jug pa sogs zhi ba'i bsnyen yig ji lta ba las/ 'dir (387)ni dgos chos mtshams gcod kyi skabs su mtshams bcad tshul gyi go don la/ khro bcu 'bar ba mtshams kyi rgyud las/ sngan de bzhin gshegs pa sngon 'byung gi rgyal po'i bstan pa la/ bram ze sam gha dang*/ dbyings ma zhes bya ba'i pha ma gnyis la bu brgyad byung ste de dag la chung ma brgyad bsus/ de'i tshe mu ge chen po zhig byung bas de dag gis mi dge bcu spong gi sdom pa blangs te thugs bskyed pa ma 'ongs pa'i gang zag rig pa 'dzin pa rnams kyis dngos grub bsgrub pa'i bar chad srung zhing mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub sbyin par smon lam btab pas/ de dag tshe 'phos pa'i phyi ma la 'og min gyi zhing du rdo rje mi bskyod pa'i sras su gyur nas pha ma gnyis steng 'og gi khro bo gnyis dang bu brgyad dang chung mar bcas pa phyogs mtshams kyi khro bo brgyad du sangs rgyas pa'i thugs bskyed dang smon lam yang dag pa'i mthus/ da lta sgrub pa gang la yang khro bo bcu'i srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgom na mi 'thad pa med cing*/ khyad par rten gzhal yas zhi khro gang yin kyang gtsug tor 'khor (388)los bsgyur ba khro bo bcu'i sa bon bh+rūm̐ las bskyed pa dgos ba de dag gis yin cing*/ dkyil 'khor gzhal yas gi rtsigs pa dang bh+rūm̐ gyi yi ge dag sbyor du 'chad pa ni/ phyogs rer bshad pa'o/ 'di la spyi dang bye brag gnyis las/ deng ni khro bcu 'bar ba mtshams kyi rgyud las bstan pa ni/ rang nyid khro bo gnod mdzes rdo rje'i tho ba dang lcags kyu 'dzin par gsal zhing hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa saṃ ha ra ṇa hūm̐ gis thugs ka nas ma dmar po zhig 'phros/ ma sur+ya maṇ+ḍa la zhes pas nyi ma'i gdan du gyur nas oṃ shrī badz+ra hūm̐ kā rā badz+ra maṇ+ḍal hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces pa'i sngags kyi rkyen las khro bo hūm̐ ka ra gsal ba ni/ hūm̐/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas shing*/ dbyar gyi char sprin lta bu'i mdog bskal pa'i me dpung bzhin du 'bar/ dor stabs tshul du zhabs bsgrad cing*/ smin mtshams khro gnyer 'bar ba can/ zhal gsum mche gtsigs rnam par 'gyur/ phyag gnyis hūm̐ gi rgya bcing nas/ rdo rje dang ni dril bu dang*/ g.yas (389)gnyis lcags kyu ral dri dang*/ g.yon gnyis dgra s+t+wa zhags pa bsnams/ 'di 'dra'i gzugs ni bsam nas kyang*/ rang gis de la bka' stsal te/ zhes dang*/ hūm̐ bzhi'i sngags dang bcas pa brjod pas gnod mdzes kyis hūm̐ kā ra la phyogs bcu'i mkha' 'gro'i gdan shom cig ces bka' stsal nas thugs ka nas tho ba dang lcags kyu thon nas gtad/ de nas hūm̐ kā ra'i zhal nas oṃ shrī ḍāk+ki rā ja badz+ra ma hā kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas bskul bas khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po sngo skya g.yas dkar g.yon dmar phyag dang po gnyis rang gi phyag rgya bcing ba/ bar ba lcags kyu dang zhags pa g.yas tha ma la gzhu/ g.yon tha ma nyi ma'i gdan bsnams pa la/ yang hūm̐ kā ras sur+ya maṇ+ḍal zhes dang hūm̐ bzhi brjod nas khro bo bcu'i gdan shoṃ cig ces bsgo ba dang mnyam du 'dod rgya gyi thugs ka nas ma bcu phyogs bcur spros te nye ma'i gdan gsal ba la/ de nas hūm̐ kā ra'i zhal nas hūm̐ khro bo'i rgyal po 'di dag ni/ (390)bgegs kyi tshogs kun kun nas bshig blo ldan rab tu sbyor ba yis/ cho ga bzhin du phur bus gdabs/ ces gsungs shing 'dod rgyal gyis phyag tu hūm̐ ka ras tho ba lcags kyu gtad pa dang*/ des phyogs bcur phyin te phyogs skyongs bcu lcags kyus bzung tho bas brdunganas nyal gyis btang nas phyogs bcur nyi ma'i steng du pho mo bsnol te bzhag ste khro bo spyan 'dren pa'i tshig 'dod rgyal gyis 'di ltar brjod par mos te/

hūm̐/ gdan bting lags so khro rgyal tshogs/ zhe sdang rdo rje'i dkyil 'khor nas/ khro chen rngams brjid sprul pa'i sku/ nyi ma'i gdan la bzhugs su gsol/ ces pas khro bo bcu spyan drangs te/ de nas 'dod pa'i rgyal po hūm̐ kā ra la thim/ de nas hūm̐ kā ras hūm̐ bcu brjod nas gzugs chen 'bar ba 'jigs byed pa/ khro bo bcu dag byung nas ni/ hūm̐ las bskyed pa'i nyi ma'i gdan/ smad ni rtse mo'i rnam par bsam/ phyogs bcu'i dkyil 'khor phyogs rnams su/ rim pa bzhin du kun tu 'khod/ bgegs rnams thams cad bshig pa'i phyir/ gnod mdzes bka' (391)byung phur pas btab/ oṃ gha gha gha ta ya sogs ces bskul zhing gnod mdzes kyis kyang*/ hūm̐/ tho ba phyag na bsnasam pa'i mchog gnod mdzes rgyal po'i rnam par bsam/ hūm̐ brjod 'bar bar blta ba yis/ bgegs kyi tshog sarnams bshig pa'i phyir/ gnod mdzes bka' rtsal phur pas thob/ gha ta ya zhes brjod cing yang gnod mdzes kyis/ hūm̐ khro bo'i rgyal po 'jigs byed bcu/ rdo rje phur bu nyid gnas pa/ ut+pal sngon po'i mdog 'dra ba/ 'bar ba'i phreng ba 'khrigs pa'i 'od/ lte ba man chad chas rnams ni/ rtse mo phur bu'i rnam pa la/ sku stod khro bo chen po ste/ zhal gsum pa la phyag drug pa/ bgegs kyi chogs rnams 'og tu gzir/ de yis sngags ni brjod byas nas/ rdo rje phur pa nges btab na/ bgegs lus shin tu mi g.yo'o/ oṃ badz+ra kro ta hūm̐ kā ra hūm̐ gharja gharja hūm̐ phaṭa/ sogs khro bo bcu'i sngags dang gha ta ya zhes brjod pas/ khro bo rnams rim pa bzhin phyogs bcu'i phyogs skyongs rnams kyi snying kar bab (392)pas lus phung ste 'og gi nyi ma'i gdan la sgrag par bsam mo/ de ltar btab pa'i dgos pa ni rgyal po btson du bzung na dmangs tsham la 'beb pa ltar bgegs kyi gtso bo phyogs skyong bcu la phur pa btab pas/ bgegs phran gzhan sdang mi nus par 'gyur ba'o/

'chad tshul gzhan du 'dod pa'i rgyal pos gdan bting nas hūm̐ kā ra la thim pa dang*/ 'og gi khro bo gnod mdzes tho ba dang bsdig mjub can gyi rnam par thon nas hūm̐ kā ra'i sked par bsdig mjub kyis bzung ste/ steng phyogs tshangs pa'i gdan du tho bas btab par bsam zhing rim par ste dang phyogs mtshams rnams btab zin pa na tho ba hūm̐ kā ra'i phyag tu gtad nas des gnod mdzes 'og gis bdag gi gdan la btab pa'i gsungs rgyun snang bas gang ltar btab kyang chog de nas yang rang gi thugs ka nas mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char 'phros te srid pa gsum gyi bgegs rnams btsom te tshur 'dus pas khro bo rnams kyi phyi rol du mtshon cha'i gur dang ra bar gyur par bsam pa'o/ gnyis pa (393)bye brag tu 'dir ni sgrub thabs ltar na/ mtshan med kyi mtshams dang mtshan bcas kyi mtshams gnyis las/ dang po ni lta ba dag mnyam bden pa dbyer med du nges pas tha mal gyi bden rang bzhin med par rtogs pa ni mtshams gcod kyi rgyal po yin pas mtshams kyi rgyal po mi rtog ye shes la/ bgegs kyi rgyal po rnam rtog mtshams chod cig zhes so/ gnyis pa mtshan bcas kyi mtshams gcod ni/ stong pa nyid de'i ngag las pad nyi la gnas pa'i hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ yig gis mtshan pa de las 'od zer 'phros rdo rje'i sa gzhi ra ba drang ba gur bla bre'i phyi rol du bskal pa'i me dpung rab tu 'bar bas bskor ba'i dbus su bh+rūm̐ las 'khor lo ser po mtshon cha'i rtsibs can cha lang kha sbyar ba ltu steng 'og gi rtsibs gnyis mdung rtse ltar steng 'og gi rdo rje'i bla bre dang sa gzhi gnyis la zug pa phyogs mtshams kyi rtsibs brgyad sbubs stong gi rnam pa rtse mo rno ba'i dbal dang ldan pa drag tu 'khor ba/ khog pa stong pa chos kyi dbyings dang mnyam pa gsung (394)ba la/ bsgom don la bsrung ba'i 'khor lo rang gi gnas kyi gnam la 'byar bar snang ba tshun tshod du bsgom pa la shes yin pas/

'khor lo'i lte ba'i dbus su pad nyi ma gnas pa'i hūm̐ sngon po 'bar bar gyur pa de las 'od zer kyis sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs dam bskul/ gcig tu rung dus nas hūm̐ la bzhugs pas/ badz+ra ma hā shri he ru ka zhes brjod pa'i rkyen gyis bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje yab yum gyi skur gsal ba/ de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las ma bcu 'phros pa rtsibs rnams kyi nang du nyi ma'i gdan bcur gyur/ slar rang rang gi thugs ka nas khro bo 'dod pa'i rgyal po 'phros te/ phyogs bcu'i gdon rnams bkugs te nyi gdan gyi steng du myos shing 'gyel stabs kyis bting ste/ zhal nas hūm̐ bzhi dang phyogs skyongs bcu'i sngags brjod de/ khro bcu'i gdan bting ba'i steng du bdag nyid zhe sdang rdo rje'i thugs ka nas hūm̐ yig bcu 'phros so so'i gdan la 'khor dpar/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha hūm̐ ka ra hūm̐ gharja gharja hūm̐ phaṭa/ sogs khro bo bcu'i sngags brjod pa'i rkyen gyis hūm̐ yig bcu po rim pa bzhin hūm̐ mdzod legs pa khro bo (395)bcur gyur te/ thams cad kyang sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa tho ba dang lcags kyu 'dzin pa sku smad phur bu 'bar ba'i rnam pa can du gyur par bsam zhing*/ de nas khro bo bdud rtsi 'khyil ba tho ba thegs pa rang gi thugs ka nas thon te oṃ gha gha gha ta sogs brjod bzhin pas khro bo rnams kyi sked pa nas bsdig mjub kyis bsnams te phur bu'i tshul du phyogs bcu'i bgegs so sor steng gi khro bo nas rim par tho bas lan gsum du btab pas bgegs rnams kyi lus 'gul mim shes/ ngag mi smra/ sems ni dran pa nyams te chos nyid du brgyal bar bsam ste/ bgegs rnams g.yo 'gul med par byas te/ slar rang khro bo de rnams las sprul pa dang yang sprul mtshon cha sna tshogs dang bcas pa'i 'od zer rnon po 'khrugs cing 'bar ba/ srung ba'i 'khor los phyogs kun gtams te cis kyang mi shig par bsam la/

'di ltar srung ba'i 'khor lo gsal ba 'di thun re re bzhin ngag gis brjod/ tshig rgyas bsdus la ma ltos par yid kyis rgyal (396)btab ste mtshams ma grol bar mi bsdu'o/ de nas bshags pa sogs dkyus bzhin btang*/ thun phyi ma gsum la rgyud sbyangs yan lag bdun pa dang*/ sems bskyed gnyis las gzhan rnams gzhan na chad pa'i skyon med do/ gnyis pa dngos gzhi ting nge 'dzin bsgom pa la khyad par gyi sbyor ba dgos ched kyi sgo nas sems bskyed pa ni/ thabs bskyed pa'i rim pa ji snyed theg pa chen po'i lam du gyur ba'i byed po yin pas/ spyir sems can thams cad ye nas sems nyid rang bzhin rnam dag gi sangs rgyas yin pa la/ de ltar ma rtogs nas med snang 'khrul pas bslus pa la snying rje chen po rtsol med du shar ba'i sgo nas 'khrul pa'i sems can rnams rang gnas kyi ye shes/ rang bzhin lhun gyis grub pa'i dkor bdun ngo bo nyid lhun gyi grub pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god par 'dod pa dang*/ khyad par du mkha' 'gro'i dgos chos sngon gyi gleng gzhi dang mthun par sems bskyed pa ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad gdug pa can gyi yul la thugs rje chen po cher khros nas gdul (397)bar mdzad pa de bzhin du shin du gdug cing gtum pa'i 'gro ba rnams la rjes su chags pa'i snying rje chen po rdo rje khro bo'i sku gsung thugs mi zad pa rgyan gyi 'khor lo'i dkyil 'khor gyi go 'phang bdag gis bsgrub nas/ log par rtog pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal zhing dbang med du 'khor ba'i sems can rnams sangs rgyas kyi sa la 'god 'dod kyis/ 'dzin pa'i dbang gis sdug bsngal zhing*/ gdug pa srid gsum 'dul ba dang*/ nga rgyal chen po brtan pa'i phyir/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba'i ting nge 'dzin bsgom/ zhes sngon kyi de bzhin gshegs pas ru tra gdug pa can 'khor dang bcas pa thabs la mkhas pas btul zhing rgyud sbyangs nas yang dag pa'i lam la bkod pa de bzhin tu byang chub tu sems bskyed par bya'o snyam du dam bca' zhing sems bskyed pa la de gal bya'o/

gnyis pa ting nge 'dzin gyi rim pa dngos la/ ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis khog dbub pa/ bdag sras dang gzhan sras kyi sgo nas rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bskyed pa las kyi rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin gsum las/ dang po la'ang gsum ste/ de bzhin nyid kyi (398)ting nge 'dzin/ kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin dang gsum ni snga 'gyur rnying ma'i chos skad thun mongs ma yin pa yin te/ gzhan gyi lugs la ye shes kyi tshogs bsags kyi rjes su bar srid lha bskyed pa las mi 'byung la 'dir ni stong nyid snying rje snying po can gyi 'phen pas sprul pa'i lha sku zhal phyag gi rnam par bzhengs nas phris las rnam pa bzhis gzhan phan sgrub pa ni tshogs gnyis zung du 'jug pa'i theg chen gyi lam ma nor ba yin zhing*/ mar ma dag 'khor ba'i dus na yang skye gnas bzhi gang du 'phen byed kyi las te sred len gyis gsos ma btab na ma la du 'jug mi nus pas/ srid len gyi gsos btab nas 'jug pa ltar/ 'dir yang thugs rje chen po'i 'phen pas gsos btab pa 'dol stong nyid kyi ngang las/ dkyil 'khor gyi lha'i skye ba 'dzin pas mar sbyangs bya dang mthun/ mthar thug gi 'bru'i gnas skabs na yang rtog pa dang bral ba'i thugs rje chen pos chos sku'i ngang las gzung skur bzhengs nas nam mkha'i mtha' khyab gyi don mdzad pa dang chos (399)mthun/ stong nyid snying rje'i rtsi dang ma bral bas bskyed rim rang rgyud du gol mi srid cing lam nges rdzogs ltar bsgom nas de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin la brtan pa thob par byas na bskyed rdzogs zung ngag tu 'gyur zhing*/ slob dpon sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs kyis bzhed pa'i zab gsal gnyis med kyi rdzogs rim mtshan nyid pa rgyud la skyes pas/ slob dpon gyis bzhed pa bskyed rim la rdzogs rim gyis rgyas btab nas bsgom pa zhes gsungs so/

'di lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin gsum po yang lam nges rdzogs ltar bsgom na shes bya lta ba'i de nyid ngo sprod gtan tshig la brten nas yid ches par byas te/ mthong ba'i rjes la 'jog pa dang rig pa spyi blugs su 'jog pa'i thabs gang rung gis sems ma bcos sprol rang babs su lhod kyis klod la dran rtogs gi 'gyu ba'i yun thag bcad de/ bying rgod kyi skyon dang bral bar bzhag cing*/ 'jog tshul sems grim lhod snyom par rtse gcig tu bzhag shes pa khong lhod la bzhag 'dzin stangs kyis ngar cha mi lhod par bzhag ngar cha (400)shor na yang sems grib su btang la bzhag sems gnas pa'i thabs sgrub tshul sgyu 'phrul zhi ba'i bsnyen yig ltar 'dir blangs te nyams lnga mthar phyin par bsgom/ zhi ba'i skabs nas bsam gtan grub zin na 'dir sa bcad re re nas thun cha shas las yun ring ser mi dgos pas/ de nyid goms pas rlung sems dbu mar 'dus te rtags bcu'i mthong snang rdzogs shing*/ gang zag dbang rab gyis snang gsum la brten pa'i dpe'i ye shes kyang bskyed nus/ de ltar min kyang stong nyid spros pa dang bral ba'i go yul dang ma bral ba'i sems gnas la brtan pa thob tshe/ mdo bzhin du snang ba'i 'khor ba la bltas nas 'dzin med sgyu ma lta bu'i snying rje mkha' khyab tu bsgom pa la snying rje dang snying rje'i ting nge 'dzin la blo sbyangs/ de nyid goms pas stong nyid la blo bzhag tshe snying rje'i rtsi dang ma bral ba/ de ltar ma rtog pa'i sems can med snang 'khrul pas bslus pa la snying rje rtsol med du skyes shing snying rje bsgom kyang*/ stong nyid kyi rtsi dang ma bral ba bdag gzhan (401)a 'thas su mi gol zhing*/ rten 'brel rang bzhin med pa sgyu ma lta bu'i snang ba las don du rang bzhin ma grub pa'i stong nyid kyi nges shes skyes ba na/ stong nyid snying rje'i snying po can la goms par bya ba ni de bzhin nyid dang kun snang gnyis ka'i don yin pas lam 'di gnyis ya ma bral bar nyams su blangs dgos pas/

gzhung gi de bzhin nyid kyi ting nge 'dzin e ma'o ngo mtshar sogs brjod nas/ de la blo 'jog tshul gong du bshad pa ltar 'jog de goms nas kun snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin e ma'o kun tu bzong ni sogs brjod de kun tu snang ba'i ting nge 'dzin ma/ de gnyis re re ya bral du sgom pas rdzogs pa'i byang chub sgrub mi nus na gnyis ka dang bral bas lta ci smros te/ grub brgya'i spyi mes pa ra has/ snying rje dang bral stong pa nyid lta ba/ des ni lam mchog rnyed pa ma yin te/ gal te snying rje 'ba' zhig bsgom na yang*/ 'khor ba 'dir gnas thar ba yod dam ci/ gang gi gnyis po sbyor bar nus pa na/ srid par (402)mi gnas mya ngan 'das mi gnas/ zhes shes rab kyis srid rtsa bden par 'dzin pa'i log rtog bcad nas srid par mi gnas shing*/ snying rjes bdag 'dod yid byed kyi 'dzin pa bcad nas zhi ba nyan rang gi mtha' la mi gnas pa/ ji skad du/ shes pas srid la mi gnas shing*/ snyang rjes zhi la mi gnas pa/ mya ngan 'das dang 'khor mi gnas/ mi gnas khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ zhes pa bzhin stong nyid snying rje snying po can de rgyal sras spyi'i lam chen yin pas nam yang ting nge 'dzin gsum ya ma bral bar bsgom pa shin tu gsang ba'i zab mo'i gnad khyad par 'phags pa 'dir ni ngo bo stong pa nyid gdangs snying rje chen po rnam pa rgyu'i yi ge zhi khro gang yang rung ba'i sa bon du gsal bas dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo'i rten brten par bcas pa stong nyid dang snying zung du 'jug pa las bskyed pa rten 'brel rang bzhin med pa'i 'char tshul du gdan gal che bas/ de lta bu'i stong nyid snying rje snying po can gyi rtsal snang rgyu'i sa bon gang yang rung ba bsgom (403)pa las skabs 'dir ni/ nges pa las ni rdo rje che/ de las dpal chen he ru ka 'bar ba chacen po gar dgu yis/ 'jigs pa yi ni dus ltar drag

zhes rang rig snang stong gnyis su med pa'i rang bzhin hūm̐ yig mthing nag tu gsal zhing 'bar bar gyur pa la sems bzung la bsgom/ de brtan pa na 'od zer spro bsdus don gnyis byas pas gnam lcags kyi rdo rje sngon po rtse dgu par bsgom pa sogs la sems can gnas sgrub tshul zhi ba ltar lags/ de nyid goms nas ci tsam 'dod kyi bar du mnyam par bzhag nus pa'i skabs su/ gzod yig 'bru de las de 'dra grangs med pa spros te nam mkha'i khyon gang ba dang*/ slar rang yig 'bru de nyid la bsdus te mnyam par 'jog pa sogs la gsal brtan gyi tshad brgyad ma thon gyi bar du bslab pa ni phra ba yig 'bru la bslab pa zhes bya ste/ 'di kho na la goms pas thun mong gi dngos grub dang grub rtags ci 'dod par sgrub nus pas/ de ltar ting nge 'dzin gsum sogs lam nges rdzogs kyi dbang du na/ (404)bskyed rim rgyas pa bdag sras dang gzhan sras/ 'bring po mngon byang lnga bskyed dang bzhi bskyed/ bsdus pa rdo rje'i cho ga sum bskyed sogs gang bsgom pa la med na thabs cha shing yod na des chog gi ting nge 'dzin yin pas 'di la goms par blo sbyang ba brtses so/ de ltar nges rdzogs tsam ma nus kyang mos sgom du byed tshe yang*/ thun thams cad mgor tshig tsam gyis chog shes mi bya bar cheg ga'i yan lag rnams rdzogs pa dang*/ blo lhod kyis klod la de ting nge dang kun snang la sems ma zin gyi bar du mnyam par bzhag de nas rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin sogs rim pa ltar sgom zhing nyams len gyi gtso bo stong nyid snying rje gnyis dang ma bral ba'i bskyed rim ma brtan gyi bar du bzlas pa dang spro bsdus sogs la do gal mi bya/ mos sgom dang nges rdzogs gang ltar bsgom kyang rim gyi skabs thams cad du ting nge 'dzin gsum ya ma bral bar sgom pa las res 'jog gis mi 'thus/ de yang dper na rtsig ngar ri mo byed pa'i tshe rtsigs pa ni gzhi yin pas de med na ri mo gang la byed/

rtsigs pa yod (405)kyang zha la med na rtsigs ngor ri mo bri mi nus pas/ zha la ni ri mo dang rtsigs pa lhan cig byed pa'i rkyen yin la/ ri mo bris zin pa'i gnas skabs na yang*/ rtsigs pa dang ri mo zha la bcas pa phun tshogs par yod pa ltar/ rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin las dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo rdzogs par bsgom pa'i gnas skabs na yang*/ stong nyid snying rje'i rtsal snang lhar shar bas gsum ka ya ma bral bar yod dgos te/ rgyu mtshan ci'i phyir snyam na/ tha mal gyi snang ba stong nyid du ma dag na dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo gang du bsgom/ des na chos thams cad stong pa nyid yin pa dang*/ 'khor 'das dbyer med yin pa'i rgyun mtshan gyis dkyil 'khor gyi 'khor lo bsgom nas mngon du byed nus pa yin zhing*/ stong nyid ni bskyed rim gyi gzhi yin te mgon po krus/ gang la stong pa nyid rung ba/ de la thams cad rung bar 'gyur/ zhes pa bzhin chos thams cad stong nyid ma yin zhing tha mal gyi snang ba bden par grub na ni bskyed rim sgom mi nus te/ ji (406)skad du/ bra sran 'bras bu dbang bskur yang*/ de la 'bras kyi dngos snang med/ ces pa ltar ye nas bden gnyis dbyer med dag mnyam chen por gnas pa la blo 'khrul bas gnas snang mi mthun par bzung ste/ log rtog bden par zhen pas tha mal gyi snang ba 'di la bden bden grub grub ltar zhen pa'i dbang gis snang ba las/ yul rang gi steng na bden par grub pa'i/ rang bzhin gyis grub pa cung zad kyang med pas snang ba 'di blos phar btags pa'i 'khrul ba med pa gsal snang nyag gcig tu 'jog pa 'dus pa mdo'i le'u nyer bdun pa dang nga gcig par gsungs pa dang*/ ngang sgom gyi rnal 'byor chen po yan chad du kun rdzob btags yod 'ba' zhig tu gsungs pa dang*/ sgyu 'phrul gyi le'u gsum pa nas/ log rtog nyid la nyid spyod pas/ log rtog sgyu ma nyid kyang ngo*/

zhes sogs kyis gsal ba dang rgyas par bstan pa ltar ro/ de nas chos thams cad stong nyid du shes kyang snying rje chen po'i 'phen pa dang bra ba ni gzhan don du gzugs kyi skur bzhengs (407)mi nus te/ nyan rang 'gog par zhugs pa la gzugs sku'i 'gra don mdzad pa mi 'byung ba yin pas/ rgyu bskyed rim gyis dkyil 'khor goms pa la stong nyid snying rje gnyis gal che bar ma zad 'brus chos kyi sku las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs pal med du mi rung bas ting nge 'dzin gsum po gal che bas rgyas par bshad pa'o/ gnyis pa rten gzhal rgyas bsgom pa dang brten pa lha bsgom pa gnyis kyis rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom pa la/ snga 'gyur ba rang lugs la skye gnas bzhi'i bag chags sbyangs ba la bskyed rim sgom tshul la yang bzhi ste/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba las/ skye gnas bzhi po dag bya'i phyir/ bskyed pa'ang de bzhin rnam pa bzhi/ spros can spros dang spros pa med/ shin tu spros pa med bzhi'o/ zhes 'khor ba'i 'dra 'bag skye gnas rnam pa bzhi'i bag chags sbyang ba la ltos te/ bskyed tshul rnam pa bzhir bstan pa'i dang po/ sgong skyes kyi bag chags sbyongs ba (408)rgyas pa chen po bdag sras dang gzhan sras rnam pa gnyis kyi sgo nas bskyed tshul yang*/ deng sang khro bo dang bka' brgyad gnyis la sbyar tshul zhig yod pa las/ sgyu 'phrul zhi ba la bdan sras gzhan sras kyi bskyed tshul gyi go ba zhig kyang chags mi snang bas/ zhi ba la sbyar ba'i tshul sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho las/ rang byung dngos dang mi 'gal zhing*/ 'brus nyid la lam shes pas/ ma lus dkyil 'khor thig le rnams/ bdag gi sras su bsgom par bya/ zhes dang*/ ye shes rtse mo las/ ji ltar sangs rgyas mthu las byung*/ lhun gyi grub pa'i cho ga dang*/ cho ga'i yan lag rdzogs pa la/ mkhas pa sangs rgyas sras yin no/ zhes so/ sgyu 'phrul rgya mtsho las/

gang gis gang la gsol btabs pas/ thugs rjes byin rlabs sbyang byas nas/ thugs zhugs 'dres pa dbyer med na/ sras gyur dgongs pa ci la gnas/ zhes pas/ sgyu 'phrul dra ba chen po rang gi rgyud kyi dngos bstan (409)gyis zhi ba la rgyas par sbyar du yod mod kyang*/ 'dir ni sgyu 'phrul khro bo dang sbyar nas 'chad pa skabs su bab pas bdag sras dang gzhan sras zhes pa'i don ni/ de'ang thog gir sgo nga dang*/ de las gzugs su smin pa ltar gnyis kyi srid pa'i bag chags sbyong ba'i gnyen po'i khyad par bdag sras gzhan sras kyi rnam pas bstan pa'i/ dong bskyed gzhi'i dbang du byas na bskyed gzhi bdag gi chos nyid bde gshegs pa'i snying po rgyu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rnam par gsal bas/ gzhan 'khor bzung ba'i snang zhen thams cad bar srid bslu ba dang mngal 'byin gyi sgo nas sras su bskrun pa la bdag gi sras su gzhan bya ba dang*/ gzhan 'khor 'das su snang zhen bzung ba thams cad dkyil 'khokar gyi gtso bo rdo rje 'dzin par gsal la bdag gi phung khams skye mched du 'dzin pa'i chos thams cad yig 'bru dang ma la 'byin gyi bya bas bskrun pas gzhan gyi sras su bdag bya ba zhes gsung zhing*/ gnyis su bskyed tshul gyi dbang gis gzhan dkyil 'khor (410)lo'i lho phyogs su snang ba thams cad bdag 'khor ba'i sems can gyi srid pa skye ba'i rim dang go bstun nas/ yab yum mnyam par sbyor ba dang ma la 'byin gyi sgo nas bskyed pa la/ bdag gi sras su gzhan bya ba zhes dang*/ bdag 'khor ba'i sems can de nyid/ gzhan dus sum gyi sangs rgyas tams cad mngon par rdzogs pa byang chub pa'i tshul lhun gyis grub pa'i cho ga'i yan lag rdzogs pa'i sgo nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo bskyed pa sangs rgyas kyi sras su bdag bya ba zhes gsungs la/ zhal rlun la snga ma rang gi rigs bde gshegs pa'i snying po'i che ba 'byin pa'i don dang*/

phyi ma de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung gi rigs rgyun mi 'chad pa'i dgos pa yin zhes gsungs so/ 'dir man ngag tu bstan pa rig 'dzin chen po pad+ma saṃ bha wa'i dgongs pa ltar 'chad pa la/ deng sgo nga dang de smin pa sems can du gyur pa bzhin/ deng bdag gi sras su gzhan bya ba la lnga/ gzhan gyi sras bdag bya ba la brgyad las/ dang po la rgyu'i sa bon las gtso bo yab yum bskyed pa dang gcig phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas bkug (411)nas yum gyi gyi mkha' ru bstim pa dang gnyis/ sems can rnams bkug la sgrib pa sbyang ba dang gsum/ gnyis su med pa la che ba brjod pa dang bzhi/ mkha' nas bton la dkyil 'khor du 'god padang lnga las/ dong ni sgrub gzhi'i rnam par smin pa'i lus ting nge 'dzin gsum gyis sbyang nas bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i steng gi bla bre'i 'og nam mkha'i dbyings su rgyu'i rdo rje 'dzin pa yum bskyed pa ni/ sgrub thabs kyi nges pa las ni sogs nas/ gar dgu dang ldan par gyur/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan te/ rgyu'i yi ge hūm̐ yig mthing nag la sems dmigs pa brtan par gyur pa na/ gzod de las hūm̐ gi 'od zer nam mkha' gang bar 'phros nas don gnyis byas mkha' khyab gyi hūm̐ rnams gzhi'i hūm̐ la thim/ de 'od du zhu ba las rdo rje sngon po rtse dgu par gyur/ yang de las 'od zer 'phros rang gzhan gyi don gnyis byas nas tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las rgyu'i he ru ka sku mdog smug nag cir yang 'gyur ba (412)rdo dang dung khrag 'dzin pa 'bar ba'i gar dgu dang ldan pa gsal nas gsal brtan gyi tshad mngon du ma gyur bar bsgom/ gnyis pa de'i mkha' nas du phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams spyan drang nas bdag gi sras su bya ba'i sa bon sgrub pa ni/ rten gzhal yas sgom pa dang*/ brten pa lha bsgom pa gnyis dang po la gsum/ gzhi dbang chen gyi dkyil 'khor sgom pa ni/ rgyu'i he ru ka'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ las yum lnga'i sa bon e yaṃ ra sum keṃ raṃ rnams chad zhes pa nas steng gi 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na zhes pa'i bar gyis gsal btab ste/

de dag kyang phyi ltar na 'byung ba ltang/ nang ltar na ye shes lnga'i rang bzhin/ gsang ba ltar na yum lnga'i mkha' klong rnam par dag pa'o/ zhes dag dran dang bcas te gsal bar bsgom/ gnyis pa rten gzhal yas bsgom pa dngos ni/ ri rab gyi steng du sogs nas 'bar ba'i phreng ba mang po 'khrugs/ zhes pa'i bar gyis bsrung ba'i 'khor lo'i lte bar 'byung (413)lnga rim brtsegs kyi ri rab gyi steng du gzha yas phyi nang rim pa gnyis phyi bhan+dha'i rin po che nang thod pa brtsegs pa'i gzhal yas khang gsal bar bsgom/ gsum pa gdan bskyed pa gzhal yas gi sogs nas/ dbang phyug lha chen logs bzung zhes pa'i bar gyis gtso 'khor rang rang dang 'tshams pa'i gdan gsal btab/ de nas gnyis pa lha bskyed pa nam mkha' gnas pa'i sogs nas 'bru'i he ru kar gyur pa ni zhes pa'i bar gyis bdag gi sras su bya ba'i sa bon sbrub pa dang*/ gsum pa sems can rnams bkug nas sgrib pa sbyangs te 'khor 'das ro gcig tu zhu ba dang*/ bzhi pa gnyis med kyi rang bzhin la che ba brjod pa rnams bstan te/ nam mkhar gnas gnag pa'i rgyu'i he ru ka skar mda' chad pa bzhin du dkyil 'khor gyi tog gi rtse mo nas mar babs/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus kyi gdan du 'khod pa las de nyid skad cig gis yal chen po sku mdog smug nag cir yang 'gyur ba dbu dang phyag (414)zhabs stong khams kyi rdul snyed dang mnyam pa mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams par gyur te/ chos nyid de bzhin nyid kyi dbyings las khro mo dbyings pyug ma chen mo mngon du phyung ste hi hi zhes dgyes pa'i mdangs kyis yab la sras bskyed par gsol ba btabs pas yab kyi zhal nas hūm̐ hū ྃhūm̐ bi shwa sogs kyi sngags brjod pa dang*/ yab yum gnyis kyi sbyor mtshams nas byang chub sems kyi sprin las gleng gzhi ltar 'jig rten drug gi phyogs bcur khyad par khro bau 'chol ba mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi char 'beb pa dpag tu med pa spros/

ltas chen po bco lnga gdug pa can gyi tshogs rnams tshar bcad nas/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi sprul pa'i khro bo rnams las rdo rje rigs kyi khro bo rnams rang la bstim pas sras kyi sa bon bskun/ gdug pa can gyi gtsor byas te sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa sbyangs/ dwang ma'i ngo bano sems nyid kyi ye shes bkugs te snga ma'i rang gi byang chub gyi sems dang gnyis med du 'dres pas 'khor 'das ro gcig tu zhu bas 'khor 'das gnyis med kyi rang (415)bzhin la che ba'i nga rgyal brjod pa ni/ bdag nyid sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ thugs dam kyi rdo rje'i bdag khro rgyal ye nas yin pa'i phyir/ zhes dang rgyal gsal ba'o/ lnga pa de'i rkyen gyis 'bras bu'i rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs pa'i mkha' gsang nas 'khor rnams bton te dkyil 'khor du 'god pa la bdag gi sras su sangs rgyas bya ba la/ sgrub thabs kyi 'bru'i he ru kar gyur pa ni/ oṃ badz+ra shrī he ru ka hūm̐ sogs nas rgyan cha lugs rnams gsal zhing gzi brjid dang ldan par gyur/ bar gyis bstan pas/ de la nang gses su 'bru'i he ru ka zhal gsum phyag drug pa sku mdog mthing nag char spyin ltar gnag pa nyi ma bye ba'i gzi byin 'bar ba/ yum gro ti shwa ri ma sngo skya zha gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa gcer bu skra grol ba lang tshos sgegs pa'i rnam 'gyur can/ stong pa nyid dang snying rje chen po zung du 'jug pa'i bdag gi can du gsal zhing*/ de nas gnyis pa rigs bsdu ba (416)ni/ sngar sngags kyis sprul pa spro ba'i rdo rje rigs kyi khro bo rnams gtso bo yab yum la bstim pa'i lhag bsam de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs dang*/ rin po che'i rigs dang*/ pad+ma'i rigs dang las kyi rigs kyi khro bo bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i tshogs spros pa rnams phyogs so sor 'dus pa gcig tu gyur nas rigs bzhi'i he ru ka'i skur gyur nas phyogs bzhi 'khor lo'i rtsibs bzhir rang rang gi gdan la bzhugs par gsal ba ni/

sgrub thabs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs sogs nas/ g.yas brkyang ba'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa'o/ zhes pa'i bar gyis gsal btab/ gsum pa sras mo nyi shu mngal 'byin gyi sgo nas bskyed pa ni/ de nas rigs lnga'i sogs nas/ gzi brjid dang ldan par bsam/ bar gyis bstan pas/ rigs lnga'i yab yum rnams rjes su chags pa'i snyom par zhugs te dgyes pa'i bzhad sgra ha zhes brjod pa dang*/ byang chub sems kyi sprin las khro mo brgyad phrag lnga thon nas slar rang rigs gcig tu bsdus te 'khor lo'i gra dang gru chad bzhir ko bo ri ma brgyad (417)gsal la/ de bzhin du he brgyad kyis gser khyams kyi phyogs mtshams brgyad du seng ha ma brgyad gsal btab/ slar yang dgyes pa'i bzhad sgra phaṭa ces brjod pa dang*/ byang chub kyi sems kyi sprin las sno skyong bzhi phrag lnga thon nas slar rigs bsdus te sgo bzhir sgo ma bzhi gsal gdab pa ste/ de dag ni yab yum gyi mkha las ngo mtshar sras kyi dkyil 'khor yum gyi mkha' las bton te dkyil 'khor la 'god pa'o/ 'di dag ni bdag gi sras su gzhan bya ba la sa bcad lngar gsungs pa 'dir sgyu 'phrul khro bo dang sbyar ste nang gi dbye ba rnams ni sgrub thabs kyi dkyus bzhin bshad pa dang*/ sgrub thabs gzhan la'ang ci rigs par sbyar du rung ba'o/ gnyis pa gzhan sras kyi bya ba la/ sno nga smin pa las sems can du gyur pa dang mthun par sbyang byed kyi gnyen po la brgyad de gco bo yab yum zhu ste rgyu'i sa bon du gyur pa dang gcig de las yab yum bskyed pa dang gnyis/ (418)yab kyi rtog tshogs las yi ge bskyed pa dang gsum/ yum las 'od 'phro zhing lha la sras bskrun par gsol ba 'debs pa dang bzhi/ dkyil 'khor thams cad bdag yab yum la bstim pas ye shes par nga rgyal bskyed pa dang lnga/ yab yum sbyor ba bya zhing mkha' ru dkyil 'khor bskyed pa dang drug

bdag gi rtog tshaugs zhe gnyis lha skur gyur te phyir 'don pa dang bdun/ ye shes pa spyan drangs shing rgyas gdab pa dang brgyad las/ dang po la zhal rgyun du gtso bo 'od du zhu nas thig le mthing nag gi gong bu sa bon phyag mtshan par gyur pa'i sgo nga*/ gnyis pa de 'bra'i rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs sgong khyim rdol nas btsas pa sogs gsung kyang*/ 'dir ni sgyu 'phrul rang gi dgongs pa ltar snang ba'i zhen pa sbyang ba dang*/ stong ba'i 'dzin pa sbyang ba gnyis las/ dong snang zhen sbyang ba la'ang bskul tshig ting nge 'dzin/ gsal gdab pa dang gsum las/ dong dkyus las gtso bo'i sogs nas/ bdag sbyor cig gi bar gyis bstan te gtso bo'i thugs (419)ka nas rig pa'i sems dpa'i rgyan ldan rnam smin gyi lus kyi rnam pa can rkang pa'i long bu sprad cing thal mo sbyar ba'i rnam par thon/ dkyil 'khor la bskor nas shar phyogs dga' ba chen po'i sgo nas me tog gtor nas/ oṃ sngon gyi thugs dam chen po ni/ 'jig rten ma lus thams cad kun/ rgyal ba'i zhing du sbyong bas na/ phyag rgya chen por bdag sbyor cig ces gsol ba bdag pa po/ gnyis pa ni sgrub thabs las/ lha rnams kyis rjes su gnang ba sogs nas/ gong bur 'bar bar bsam/ kyis bstan pas lha rnams kyis bdag la rjes su dgongs te thabs dang shes rab gyi 'od zer spros pas/ bdag gi sems byung gi rtog pa dang*/ de las gyur pa'i rnam smin gyi lus ngag sbyangs/ gzung 'dzin gnyis bral gyi rang bzhin gser zhun ma lta bu'i gong bur gyur pa la de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi sku gsung thugs kyi 'od zer yi ge gsum gyi rnam pas bdag la bstim pas gong bu nyid kyang de dang gnyis su med pa'i (420)oṃ āḥhūm̐ gsum du gyur nas oṃ āḥl thim/ āḥhūm̐ la zhugs pa zla ba dang rlung gi dkyil 'khor la bcas par gyur pa de rlung gis btegs pas bung ba me tog la lding ba ltar dkyil 'khor thams cad la lan gsum bskor nas gtso bo'i thugs kar mda' 'phang ba ltar song ba'i rkyen gyis yab yum bde ba'i rol mos chim nas byang chub kyi sems dang gnyis su med par zhu ba sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mor son pa 'od kyi gong bur gnas pa las gtso bo yab yum rkyang rjes su chags pa'i sbyor bas bde ba'i ngo bor zha/

'khor rnams kyang hūm̐ ha he phaṭa ces rang gi gsang sngags brjad pas rkyen gyis dbus kyi thig le la ro gcig tu g.yur pa las gser zhun lta bu'i 'od kyi gong phur 'bar bar bsam/ zhal rgyun du gtso 'khor rnams 'od du zha ba rang gi kha dog can sa bon gyis mtshan pa rang rang gi gdan thog tu sgong khyim bkram pa ltar gsal ba zhig snang*/ gsum pa ni gzhung gi thabs dang shes rab gnyis med pa/ ye shes zer gyis rnam rtog (421)sbyang*/ gser zhun lta bu'i las/ gsung gi byin rlabs 'od kyi 'bru/ thugs kar thim nas sku yi dbyings/ rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi mkhar/ chos sku byang chub sems gnas rnams so sor snying po'i sgras/ hūm̐ ha he phaṭa ces byung nas/ byang chub sems su gcig par thim/ zhes shin tu gsal gdab po/ gnyis pa stong phyogs kyi zhen pa sbyang ba/ de las 'bru'i rtso rje 'dzin pa yab yum du skye mched rdzogs pa sgong khyim rdol ba ltar bskyed pa la/ sgrub thabs las gtso bo yab yum bskyed pa/ yan lag gi lha bsgom pa/ 'khor spro ba gsum du bstan pa'i dang po ni/ hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes pa nas dbang phyug chen po ngo bor bzhugs pa'i bar gyis bstan te/ bka' brgyad las/ 'di nas chos nyid stong pa'i dbyings nas yum gnam zhal dbyings kyi dbang phyug ma mthing skya dbu dgu phyag bco brgyad pa'i rnam par bzhengs te bcom ldan 'das chos sku zhi ba'i dbyings las gzugs kyi skur bzhengs par bskul ba/ (422)ye shes rgya mtsho rnam par grol ba'i klong*/ sogs kyis bskul ba gsan nas 'bru'i rdo rje 'dzin par bzhengs par gsungs kyang*/ 'dir ni hūm̐ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas gdan steng gi 'od phung de nyid hūm̐ zung gcig tu gyur pa 'od zer gyi 'phro 'dus don gnyis byas/ slar 'dus hūm̐ la thim/ 'od du zhu ba las/ oṃ ghaṇ+ḍe zhes brjod pas rdo rje rtse dgu pa dang dril bu hūm̐ yig gi mtshan par gyur pa las/

slar 'od zer gyi 'phro 'dus 'od du zhu ba las/ oṃ shrī he ru ka hūm̐ sogs gong bzhin du gtso 'khor bskyed pa'o/ nang gses gnyis pa yan lag gi lha bskyed ni/ rang gi thugs kar rin po che'i gur khyim sogs/ at+ma ko3 haṃ bar gyis sems can sum brtsegs su gsal ba la/ lngas dbang bskur/ rdo rje gsum gyis rgyas gdab pa'o/ rtsa ba'i gsum pa yab kyi rtog tshogs yi ge bskyed pa dang*/ sgrub thabs kyi gsum pa tshar sras kyis dkyil 'khor spro ba dang*/ dbang phyug ma nyer brgyad kyi dkyil 'khor spro ba gnyis kyi dbang po sras spro (423)ba la'ang*/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs pa/ gsal gdab pa/ sku bskyed pa dang gsum las/ dong ni sgrub thabs las/ yab kyi gsang gnas sogs nas/ bkra lam gyis gsal bar gyur gyi bar gyis bstan pas/ 'dis rtsa ba'i gsum pa dang po yul la sad pa'i rtog tshogs yi ge'i sprin du spros nas lha'i dkyil 'khor du sgrub pa'i yab gyi rtsa khams su hūm̐ ha he phaṭa kyi yi ge gsal ba dang*/ rtsa ba'i bzhi pa yum las 'od 'phros lha la gsol ba gdab pa ni/ yab yum 'dod chags nga ro brjod/ byin gnyis dam du rab 'khyung de/ lag pa dam 'khyud ma mchu gzhib/ sangs rgyas kun gyi ye shes sku/ ngang nyid rdo rje chos dbyings las/ 'bar ba'i khro bo mi bzad pa/ sku'i dbyig tu sras bskyed cig ces pas gsol ba btab par bsam mo/ rtsa ba'i lnga pa bka' brgyad ltar lha gnas so so na sa bon sgong khyim ltar bkram pa'i dkyil 'khor thams cad gtso (424)bo'i shangs kyi rlung ring nang du rngub pa dang lhan cig par sgong khyim thams cad shangs kyi rlung dang 'dres nas/ rang gi byang chub kyi sems la bstim par bsam nas/ 'dod chags chen po'i tshul gyis ni/ ye shes dkyil 'khor kun bsdus te/ 'khor rnams thugs la zhugs pa yis/ shes rab ma ni dga' bar bya/

ces pa bsam mo/ rtsa ba'i drug pa mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs te/ phyag rgya bzhis snyom par zhugs pa sgrub thabs gzhung gis dngos su bstan pa ste/ chags pa lcags kyu zhes bya ste/ smar chud pa zhags pa mo/ kha 'byed pa ni skrog yin te/ sgra grags pa ni dril bu'o/ zhes phyag rgya bzhis snyom par zhugs nas bde ba chen pa'i sgra dang 'od zer gyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bkug nas zhal du zhugs pas rjes su chags pa'i mes byang chub kyi sems su zhu ba sku'i dbyibs brgyud rdo rje'i lam nas yum gyi pad+mor lan gsum du spros pa las/ bka' brgyad ltar na/ chos sku byang chub sems su gnas/ dang por bab pa gzhal med khang*/ gnyis (425)pa gdan gyur gsum pa las/ yab gyi rtog tshogs yi ger brdzod/ bha ga nyid du lha rnasam bsam/ zhes yi ge'i sa bon rnasam yongs su gyur pa las yum 'khor lha tshogs gsal gdab pa/ lha so so'i gsang sngags brjod pa'i rkyen gyis sku yongs su rdzogs par gyur pa de rnams jaḥzhes brjaud pa tsam gyis yum gyi mkha' nas bton tan mdun gyi nam mkhar bzhugs pa la oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis sku gsung thugs su byin gyis brlabs/ 'od zer spro bsdus sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa sgrub nas rang rang gi gdan la bzhugs par bsam pa'o/ sgrub thabs 'dir ni byang chub kyi sems yum gyi mkhar lan gsum du spros pa'i dang pos thig gdab/ gnyis pas gzhal g.yas du byin gyis brlabs/ gsum pas zhal der lha de rnams kyi sa bon yig 'bru'i dkyil 'khor bkra lam gyis gsal bar bsam la/ gnyis pa de'i don nan tan gyi gsal gdab pa ni/ bsnyen pa dang ni nye bsnyen dang*/ sgrub pa dang ni sgrub chen po/ yum gyi pad+ma'i (426)dkyil 'khor du/ bde ba thugs kyi dkyil 'khor spro/ sangs rgyas sprin tshogs ma lus pa/ dgyes mnyam mchog gi sbyi pas bstim/ zhes so/

rtsa ba'i bdun pa bdag gi rtog tshogs lhar gyur nas phyir 'don pa ni/ gsum pa lha bskyed pa ni oṃ badz+ra m+hā shrī nas dz+wa la ni hūm̐ phaṭaḥ zhes sogs nas zhal phyogs nas 'khod pa'o/ zhes pa'i bar gyis ngo mtshar sras kyi dkyil 'khor rigs lnga ko bo seng sgo ma bzhi bcas ma la 'byin gyi sgo nas spros pa ni gtso bo'i sngags brjod pa'i rkyen gyis yum mkhar gzhal yas gi dbus kyi hūm̐ gnyis badz+ra he ru ka yab yum gyi skur gyur pa phaṭa jaḥzhes pas mkha' las spros te mdun g.yi nam mkhar bzhugs par gyur pa 'od zer gyi spro bsdus sangs rgyas mdzad pa sgrub ste bdag nyid gtso bo yab yum la thim nas gnyis su med par gyur bar bsam mo/ de bzhin du rigs bzhi'i sa bon rnams rim pa bzhin rigs bzhi'i he ru ka yab yum gyi skur gyur pa phaṭa jaḥs mkha' las bton te phyogs bzhi'i gdan gyi nam mkhar (427)bzhugs nas sngar bzhin 'od zer spro bsdus sbyor bas sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa sgrub ste phyogs bzhir rang rang gi gdan steng du bzhugs par gsal gdab/ de bzhin du ko bo ri ma brgyad/ seng ha ma brgyad sgo ma bzhi dang bcas pa ma la 'byin cho gas bskyed nas/ gnyis pa dbang phyug ma nyi shu rtsa brgyad ni/ gleng gzhi'i skabs bzhin sras mo nyi shu bskyed pa'i yum du gyur pas mngal 'byin gyis mi bskyed par bdag gi badz+ra he ru kar gsal ba'i thugs ka nas bh+yo yig nyer brgyad 'phros pa las rang sngags brjod pa'i rkyen gyis khyams phyi ma'i phyogs bzhir drug dang sgo bzhir re re rang rang gi stan la 'khod par gsal gdabapa ste lha thams cad kyi srog gi gor ye shes sems dpa' dwangs ma'i srog yig bcas pas mtshan pa gsal theb par bya'o/ rtsa ba'i brgyad pa phyag rgya bzhi'i bcing nas ye shes spyan drangs shing rgyas gdab pa ni/ sgrub thabs las gsal gdab pa la sngags dang tshig gis gsal gdab pa'i (428)phyi ma la che ba bskyed pa dang gsal gdab dngos gsung pa rnams kyis mtshan pas hūm̐ ha he phaṭa nas 'bar ba'i dkyil 'khor gsal bar snang*/

zhes pa'i bar gyis bstan te phyag rgya bzhi'i rgyas ching gis bcing ba ni/ de ltar gsal ba'i lha tshogs rnam sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs rnams la gsal snang thon pa ni sku phyag rgya chen po/ bsam pa chos kyi phyag rgya ni lha rnams kyi srog gi gor rang 'dra'i ye shes sems dpa'i dwangs ma'i srog yig dang bcas pa gsal ba brjod pa chos kyi phyag rgya lha rnams kyi rang rang gi bskyed sngags brjod pa rnams yin la/ bca' ba dam tshig gi phyag rgya dang bkrol ba las kyi phyag rgya gnyis 'og gi phyag rgya'i mchod pa'i skabs kyi/ hūm̐ rnam par grol ba mtshon pa'i phyir/ dbus kyi khro bo'i phyag rgya ni/ sogs kyis mtshon pa'i bca' ba dam tshig phyag rgya dang dkrol ba las kyi phyag rgya bzhi dang ldan par gsal ba rnams yin no/ de dag la che na bskyed pa ni/ rgyud las sa la sogs (429)par phyag rgya byas/ rnam grol rim par thob 'gyur na/ dag pa'i ye shes kyis sbyang bas/ smros cing dgos te de nyid yin/ cas pas phyag rgya bzhis rdo rje 'chang gis dngos grub sgrub pa la mi bslu bar byin gyis brlabs pa'i don la nges pa'i blo bzhag go de ltar phyag rgya bcings shing gsal gdab nas ye shes pa spyan drangs shing sku gsung thugs dang ye shes lngas rgyas gdab pa ni sgrub thabs kyi gsum pa las kyi rim pa'i ting nge 'dzin la nang gses drug gi dang po la bzhi/ snyan gsan dbab pa/ spyan drangasha ba dngos/ rig pa'i me tog dor ba/ dngos grub bskul ste bstim pa rnams kyis/ bstan pas bsgrub thabs kyi dkyus bzhin du shes par bya'o/ des na snga dro las byang rgyas pa btang nas bsnyen pa'i mgor lha'i gsal snang la bslab/ thun phyi ma gsum la sems bskyed nas lha bskyed rgyas pa btang*/ spyan 'dren bzhugs gsol gnyis gzhung bzhin la/ mchod pa kun (430)bzhi bsnol dang*/ sman raka gtor gsum sngags tsam dang*/

bstod pa gzhung bzhin du btang nas bshags pa dang dngos grub gsol ba dam bca' ba gsum bzhag kyang chog la/ bsnyen pa'i mgor lha'i gsal snang la bslab pa'i tshul khrid thang mdun mchad pa mtshon tsam bshams/ rang nyid de'i mdun du nye ring 'tshams par 'dug nas lha sku la mig gis blta zhing*/ yang mig btsum nas de 'dra yid la e shar bltas nas bsgom tshul zhi ba'i bsnyen yig ltar lha snang la bslab pa/ nga rgyal la bslab pa/ dag dran la bslab pa rnams 'dir blangs te/ khyad par khro bo la spyan dbus ma nas sems 'dzin pa la bslab ste/ badz+ra he ru ka sku mdog mthing nag byar gyi char sprin ltar gnag pa/ nyi ma bye ba'i gzi byin 'bar ba/ dbu gsum gyi g.yas g.yon gnyis la mgrin pa dang bcas pa gsal ba las mgo gsum lhan du 'byar ba 'dra ba zhig min pas g.yas zhal dkar la (431)bzhad pa/ g.yon zhal dmar la gshe ba/ dbus mthing nag drag po khros pa'i nyams can/ zhal re rer dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa rnam par 'gyur ba'i zhal gdangs shing mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ glogs ltar 'khyugs pa'i ljang 'dril ba/ rdo rje'i gad mos sa gsum g.yo ba khro gnyer bsdus pa'i shangs nas mi bzad pa'i hūm̐ sgra 'byin pa/ rdzi smin sma ra las 'bar ba'i me 'khyogs sor 'bar ba/ sku che zhing yan lag rags pa lang tshau rgyas pa'i 'gyur bag can rdo rje ba sprus gtams pa/ de yang chags nyams kyis sgegs pa/ khro nyams kyis dpa' ba/ rmongs nyams kyis mi sdug la ste sku'i gar gsum/ ha ha hi hi logs bzhad pa'i gad mo 'byin pa/ zungs shig rgyob cig logs pa gshe ba/ de dag kyang 'brug stong dus gcig la ldir ba'am thog stong dus gcig la lhung ba lta bu'i sgra gdangs dang ldan pa'i drag shul ste gsung (432)gi gar gsum/ rmongs pa'i 'gro khams rjes su 'dzin pa'i snying rje dang*/ ma rung ba'i sems can khro bas 'dul ba'i rngam pa/

thams cad chos nyid du ro mnyam par gzigs pa'i zhi ba ste thugs kyi gar gsum dang ldan pa/ de ltar gar gyi nyams dgu rab tu rgyas pa me dpung 'bar ba'i dbus na zhabs bzhi g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum pa'i gyad chen po'i stabs kyis rang rang gi gdan la rol pa/ de ltar gsal thebs par gsal gdab la bsgom/ de yang lha snang spyi dang bye brag rgyan phyag mtshan sogs la sems 'dzin tshul ni zhi ba'i bsnyen yig ltar lags/ de ltar goms pas mdun gyi lha sku la gsal snang legs par thon pa na gzod de rang gi lus la spos te bsgom pas nam zhigs la brtan gyi tshad brgyad 'byung ste/ de la gsal ba'i tshad bzhi ni/ de yang lha sgom yang sku'i snang cha spyan gyi dkar nag tshun chad ma 'dres par gsal bas gsal le/ de yang rig pa'i gsal ngar dang bral ba'i bying nyams can (433)ma yinapa rig pa gsal stong seng bag dang bcas pa'i rig pa ngar dang ldan pas seng nge*/ sgom pa'i lha de dag kyang sems med bem po'i rnam pa 'ja' tshon lta bu ma yin par ba spu'i khung bu dang skra'i nyag ma tshun chad rnam pa thams cad pa'i ye shes kyis zin pa'i dbang shes dwangs pa'i yon tan brgya phrag tu 'char zhing bkra hrig ge bzhugs pas na lhag ge de lta bu'i sku de yang de ltar yin no ba dang yod do tsam gyis rjes dpag gi blo rtog ma yin par yid ngo na mngon su lta bu bkra lhang nge 'char ba ste gsal ba'i tshad bzhi/ a su bkrin can gyis khong gi rta thog 'bu dus zhabs g.yon pa yob chen nang bzhag nas g.yas yob non bar du bkyad kyi bdun brgya nyer lnga'i lha tshogs rnams sku mdog phyag mtshan rgyan cha lugs rnams ma 'dres bar gsal nus kyang da dung 'di bskyed rim mtshan nyid pa ci yin snang med/ khyed rnams kyis bskyed rim 'di rtsis med du ma 'dor (434)bar gsalal brtan gyi tshad brgyad ma byung bar bsgom dgos zhes bdag gi bla ma bkrin can la gsung bas/

de ltar gsal brtan gyi tshad mngon du ma gyur bar bsgom dgos/ brtan pa'i tshang bzhi ni le logs pa spyi'i skyon gyis mi g.yo/ rab rib mgo bo logs 'gyur ba'i skyon gyis mi 'gyur/ de yang yun thung ngu tsam ma yin par nyin mtshan du mnyam par bzhag kyang rnam rtog phra mos kyang mi brdzi bar gsal ba mngon par mi 'gyur ba/ sku mdog dang zhal phyag dang byon bzhugs dang 'od zer spro bsdu'i rnam pa logs ji ltar bsgom yang de ltar 'byung ba ni cir yang 'gyur du btub pa ste brtan pa'i tshad bzhi'o/ lar lha bsgom pa'i dus gsal zhing bzhag pas bzhang tu btub pa ni yon tan yin cing bsgom pa'i dus ha cang mi gsal zhing ma bsgom na lha sku'i rnam pa yid ngor lam lam gsal ba dang*/ gsal ba de nyid la zhen pa yod na skyon yin pas gsal snang goms nas bsdu (435)rim la sbyangs dgos pa gnad du che bas deng sang phal che bas thun rjes ma ma gtogs bsdu rim mi byed zer ba dang*/ yang dus rgyun dkyil 'khor gsum dang ma bral bar byed dgos pas bsdu rim mi byed zer ba sogs ni bskyed sna tshogs kyi gnad thun mong ma yin pa'i phyogs tsam yang mi shes pa dang*/ gya nom ltar zhen gyi mtshan 'dzin la skyon du ma mthong ba'i rmongs pa'i rang rtags zangs mar bstan par zad do/ des na bsdu rim ni 'chi ba'i bag chags sbyongs shing chos sku rten 'brel bsgrigs pa dang*/ sgyu lus 'dom du bsdu ba'i rdzogs rim gyis lam gyis smin byed yin par ma zad/ spyir rdo rje theg pa'i lam gyi yon tan thams cad rdo rje'i lus la gnad du bsnun nas rtsa rlung thig le dbu mar 'dus pa'i byed pa las skye brgyan stag yin zhing*/ dpe don gyi 'dol gang rgyud la bskyed cing 'byung ba'i sdud rim las rtags bcu'i snang ba char zhing rang bzhin gyis thim rim las snang gsum gyi 'dol shar ba'i (436)klong du tha mal gyi 'khrul snang thams cad nub nas snang gsum 'dol du thim pa'i gnas skabs na chos nyid spros pa dang bral ba'i ye shes 'char ba nges pa can yin pas mtshan mo gnyid 'thug dang rmi lam gyi dge sbyor la brtson par 'dod pa dang*/

nyin mo rlung sems dbu mara'adus pa'i thabs la spro ba yod pa dang*/ thuno nga ma yin pa'i rdzogs rim sgyu lus dang 'dol mngon du byed 'dod pa dang*/ de las tha mal gyi lus rten dor nas slob pa'i zung ngag gi go 'phang mngon du byed par 'dod pa dang*/ gal te tshe 'dir ma grol kyang bar do dang po'i 'dol chos sku'i dgongs pa la mnyam par bzhag nas zung ngag gi longs spyod rdzogs skur bzhengs par 'dod pa rnam kyis ni bskyed rim gyi rjes su bsdu rim la do gal bya dgos so/ de ltar ma yin par yi dam gyi gsal snang dang*/ spro bsdu'i dmigs pa tsam la brten nas 'dre 'dul dang bsrung skyobs kyi phris phran bu re sgrub par 'dod pa rnams la ni mu stegs byed dang thun mong ba'i gsal

skur bzhengs bar 'dod pa dang*/ mthar thug ma rig bag chags kyis mi yid lus kyang 'od la bsdus mi slob yi zung ngag gi snang dang nga rgyal des (437)chog go 'di ngag gi skabs su 'gyad kyi rgyud gsang ba yongs rdzogs dang he ru ka rgyud dpang por bzhag ste brtsad pas chog go de yang lha snang la brtan pa khyad par can thob pa'i bsnyen pa ci tsam btang ba'i phyed phan chad na zhi ba'i skabs ltar rdzogs rim la bslab par bya'o/ de yang bskyed rim la a 'thas shing rdzogs rim la mi mos pa dang*/ rdzogs rim gyis stong nyid skad la zhen nas bskyed rim bcos ma ni lam du go nas bskyed rdzogs ya bral du nyams su len par 'dod bdag ni/ sangs rgyas chos gzugs gnyis kyi thun mong ma yin pa'i rgyu sgyu lus dang 'dom gnyis la skur ba btab pa'i rnam smin ngan song las 'gro sa med pa rgyu 'bras nges pa chod ma'i rig pas grub po/ de nas bsnyen pa btang ba jap+da khang dbye ba sogs zhi ba'i skabs ltar la/ bsnyen pa rgyas pa'i dbang du na gtso bo yab yum gyi rtsa sngags dang ru lu sbrel ba bye ba gcig 'khor rigs bzhi'i (438) la de'i bzhi cha/ ko bo seng dbang phyug sgo mang rnam la de'i bzhi cha/ bsdus pa'i dbang du na gtso bo yabu ma la ru lu sbrel ba bzhi/ rigs lngar re/ ko seng sgom dbang phyug nyer brgyad bcas la rang sngags dang ru lu sbrel ba khri re rer bcas/ shin tu bsdus pa ni gtso bo yab yum sngags rkyang bzhi/ de bzhin rigs bzhi re/ 'khor rnams khri re ru lu rkyang pa bye ba gcig bcas lam mos sgom pa'i dbang du byas pa'o/ nges rdzogs kyi dbang du na rtags dus grangs kyi bsnyen pas dbye ba'i rab 'bring tha ma'i rtags rdzogs kyi bar du bya bar gsungs so/ thun mjug thams cad du bstod bshags ye shes bsdu ba dang bcas pa grub pa dang*/

thun mtshams kyi bya ba nyer bsdu go bgo lus srung man chad gzhung bzhin du bya'o/ 'dir ni sgyu 'phrul khro bo'i dgos chos rnams bshad pa'i khyad par ma gtogs sbyor dngos rjes kyi bya ba phal cher zhi ba'i bsnyen yig las shes par bya dgos (439)pa kho na'o/ slar smras pa/ mdo sgyu sems gsum rgyu dang legs bshad gzhung*/ mtshan tsam thos pa'i bsod nams bsam 'das na/ 'chad rtsod rtsom pas gtan la 'beb pa 'di/ bskal mang bsod nams mthu las yin no snyams/ rgyal ba'i bstan pa snyigs mar gzim la nye/ rang 'dod 'byung bya'i dga' ston shar ba'i dus/ thos bsam bsgom par nges pa'i blo dman yang*/ skal bzang don mthun 'ga' la phan blos bris/ ma rtogs log par rtogs pa'i nyes pa'i cha/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro'i srung ma dang*/ chos kyi spyan ldan 'phags mgon rnams kyi drung*/ thog med bsags pa'i sdig dang lhan cig 'chags/ 'dis thob dge ba nyin byed 'bum brdal bas/ snga 'gyur rang lugs sad tshal rgyas pa dang*/ grub gnyis yid bzhin 'jo ba'i dga' ston gyis/ ma lus skye dgu'i re ba sgong bar shog (440)ces pa'ang sgyu 'phrul khro bo'i bsnyen pa ji ltar btang ba'i tshul rag dgon mchog sprul thub bstan bshad sgrub rgya mtshos dngos dang yi ge'i lam nas snga phyir bskul ba dang*/ rgya ra mkhan po mgon pos kyang ched du bskul ba'i ngor dpal kaḥthog pa chen po si tu chos kyi rgya mtsho'i bkrin kyis 'tshe ba pad+ma las 'brel rtsal gyis dpyad gsum dag pa'i sgo nas spel ba'o/// /
